facts.fact: 她抱住 Archie 时心里算的是：把 Peake 秘书封在树里而不杀，算不算杀人。
facts.anchor: Was it murder if they had trapped Secretary Peake in a tree rather than killing him?

facts.fact: 她这才意识到两人从前从未拥抱过。
facts.anchor: Belatedly Kiamling realised they had never embraced before.

facts.fact: Archie 退开半步，两人之间的那段距离忽然成了一道深谷。
facts.anchor: the distance between them suddenly a chasm

facts.fact: Madam Yau 说 Peake 是个填不满的暴徒，她起初接他的生意，因为他出手阔绰。
facts.anchor: He was an insatiable brute. Violent. I accepted his custom at first, his pockets were deep.

facts.fact: Kiamling 说那栋楼与那棵树是一道门，他的情绪是通道，他自称 Merlin。
facts.anchor: The building, the tree was a doorway. His emotions providing the conduit. He called himself Merlin.

facts.fact: Archie 说这不可能，Merlin 只是传说、是民间故事。
facts.anchor: “That’s not possible. Merlin is a legend. A folk tale.”

facts.fact: Jingling 接过话头，把破坏说成一场范围极小的台风。
facts.anchor: “Damage was caused by a localised typhoon,” Jingling smoothly finished for her.

facts.fact: 她补说 Peake 秘书不幸在混乱中失踪，同行的还有许多无辜者。
facts.anchor: “Very localised. Secretary Peake unfortunately went missing in the chaos. Alongside many other innocents.”

facts.fact: Archie 只肯接受这是唯一合乎逻辑的解释。
facts.anchor: “It’s the only logical explanation.”

facts.fact: 他对教会与政府的信念太硬，硬到能装作没看见亲眼见过的东西。
facts.anchor: So resolute was his belief in his Church and his government that he could pretend not to see things he had witnessed with his own eyes.

facts.fact: 地板朝她扑来，她当场昏了过去。
facts.anchor: The floor hurtled towards her as she fainted.

facts.fact: 她想起自己是被一头会变形的鹿顶伤了大腿。
facts.anchor: a shapeshifting deer had gored her

facts.fact: Jingling 拿她打呼噜比水牛来激她睁眼。
facts.anchor: your snoring rivals a water buffalo

facts.fact: 她认出妹妹素袍上系的那条结带是自己的。
facts.anchor: Wait, Kiamling recognised that knotted belt Jingling was wearing round her simple robes; it was hers!

facts.fact: 断掉的肋骨在妹妹渡来的气里合拢，伴着一阵灼热。
facts.anchor: The broken rib knitted its edges back together, a thrum of intense heat as her sister’s qi healed her.

facts.fact: 她终于说出谢谢，忍着妹妹那串得意的哼哼。
facts.anchor: “Thank you!” she repeated, ignoring the gloating noises Jingling made.

facts.fact: Jingling 说她不爱打，可不等于没本事，她照样学会引气，气比姐姐想的多。
facts.anchor: “I don’t like fighting, but it doesn’t mean I have no skills whatsoever. I still learnt how to access my qi. I have more than you think.”

facts.fact: 她告诉妹妹：你是灵媒。
facts.anchor: You are a spirit medium.

facts.fact: 她承认找到裂口时它还开着，她只是不敢进去。
facts.anchor: The rift was still open when I found it. I was just too scared to go through.

facts.fact: 她承认自己有一小块为此庆幸，为此觉得羞耻。
facts.anchor: an awful, shameful part of me was glad she’d been taken

facts.fact: Jingling 最后说：那就招个鬼来问。
facts.anchor: “Hou la,” Jingling said finally. “Let’s summon a ghost.”
